import sys,sqlite3,hashlib,json,os
from pathlib import Path
mode=sys.argv[1];p=Path('/data/qualification.db')
if mode=='init':assert not p.exists(),'Refuse to overwrite an existing database'
else:assert p.is_file(),'Original database is missing'
db=sqlite3.connect(str(p));db.execute('PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL');db.execute('PRAGMA synchronous=FULL')
if mode=='init':
 db.execute('CREATE TABLE records (seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, payload TEXT NOT NULL)')
 db.executemany('INSERT INTO records VALUES (?,?)',[(i,hashlib.sha256(('csi-lab-'+str(i)).encode()).hexdigest()) for i in range(1000)])
 db.commit();db.execute('PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(FULL)')
elif mode=='append':
 assert db.execute('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM records').fetchone()[0]==1000
 db.executemany('INSERT INTO records VALUES (?,?)',[(i,hashlib.sha256(('csi-lab-'+str(i)).encode()).hexdigest()) for i in range(1000,2000)])
 db.commit()
rows=db.execute('SELECT seq,payload FROM records ORDER BY seq').fetchall();prefix=[v for v in rows if v[0]<2000]
for seq,payload in prefix:assert payload==hashlib.sha256(('csi-lab-'+str(seq)).encode()).hexdigest()
integrity=db.execute('PRAGMA integrity_check').fetchall();assert integrity==[('ok',)]
hashvalue=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(prefix,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
st=os.statvfs('/data');print(json.dumps({'rows':len(rows),'prefix_rows':len(prefix),'prefix_sha256':hashvalue,'integrity':'ok','filesystem_capacity_bytes':st.f_blocks*st.f_frsize}))
